description: This file contains functional test cases for WebPA commands, specifically for setting and getting an Account ID via a mock parodus process. It utilizes subprocess calls and custom grep functions to validate logs and responses.

methods.name: test_WebPA_Set_ACC_Id()
methods.description: Tests setting the Account ID using a WebPA command, validates the command execution and log messages.

methods.name: test_WebPA_Get_ACC_Id()
methods.description: Tests retrieving the Account ID through a WebPA command, checks for successful response and correct value in logs.
